title.text: Dubai: Helicopter Adventure Above The Palm

pills.label: 12–30 min
pills.pop_html: Pick your length: The €175 from-price is the 12-minute flight, about €14.61 per minute. The same tour sells longer options up to 30 minutes, so you can upgrade on the booking page without switching tours.

pills.label: Palm + Burj Khalifa
pills.pop_html: Route on the 12 minutes: Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis, Atlantis The Royal and Burj Al Arab, then Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Canal and Business Bay with the JW Marriott Marquis.

pills.label: Pickup option
pills.pop_html: Transfers: Choose the "with transfer" option for air-conditioned hotel pickup and drop-off anywhere in Dubai. Without it you make your own way to the helipad.

pills.label: Live commentary
pills.pop_html: On board: Live English commentary, with an optional English audio guide. Private flights are available as well as small groups.

best_for.pick_html: for a first helicopter ride that covers the Palm, Burj Al Arab and Burj Khalifa at the lowest price in Dubai, €175, with hotel pickup if you want it.
best_for.skip_html: if Old Dubai, the Creek or the Dubai Frame are on your list: the 12-minute route stops at Business Bay.

items.a: Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
HeliDubai helipad at the Dubai Police Academy, Jumeirah.
Hotel pickup and drop-off anywhere in Dubai with the "with transfer" option.
12 to 30 minutes, chosen at booking.
Age 2+, safety weight limit 115 kg, no passengers 140 kg or over.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai: 17-Minute Helicopter Tour over Palm Jumeirah

pills.label: 17 min from €233
pills.pop_html: Cheapest per minute: The tour is built around a 17-minute flight but also comes as a 12-minute one, so check the length on the option you select. At 17 minutes, €233 is €13.73 a minute, the lowest rate here, and €58 more than the 12-minute flight on #1.

pills.label: Max 5 guests
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group limited to 5 participants, with a live English-speaking guide. The tour is wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Palm to Meydan
pills.pop_html: Route: Burj Al Arab, Palm Jumeirah, Atlantis and Atlantis Royal, The World Islands, Jumeirah Beach, Port Rashid, Burj Khalifa, Business Bay, Dubai Mall, Mall of the Emirates and the mile-long Meydan Racecourse grandstand.

pills.label: Transfer add-on
pills.pop_html: Getting there: Return transfer is only included if you add it at checkout. Water is served on arrival.

best_for.pick_html: for a longer Palm loop in a group capped at 5: 17 minutes from €233, with The World Islands, Dubai Mall and Meydan added to the Palm route.
best_for.skip_html: if you want the lowest total price (the 12-minute flight is €58 cheaper) or Old Dubai and the Creek (book the 22 minutes).

items.a: Narrated helicopter flight, complimentary water on arrival.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
HeliDubai Helicopter Tours, Dubai Police Academy, Al Sufouh 1, Dubai.
Return transfer only if the add-on is selected at checkout.
Children under 2, pregnant women.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

title.text: Dubai: Sightseeing Helicopter Ride from The Palm

pills.label: 3 window seats
pills.pop_html: Seating: Each helicopter has 6 seats, 3 of them at a window. Exclusive flights take up to 6 guests, or 7 on the 7-seater, with a 430 kg total weight limit.

pills.label: 12, 15, 17 or 25 min
pills.pop_html: Routes by length: 12 min: Burj Khalifa, Burj Al Arab and the coast. 15 min adds The World Islands, Port Rashid and the Palm. 17 and 25 min cover all main landmarks; 25 min adds Ski Dubai, Dubai Marina, JLT and Media City.

pills.label: Atlantis departure
pills.pop_html: Where you fly from: Take-off and landing at Atlantis The Palm. The exact meeting point varies by option, so confirm it in your booking before you set off.

pills.label: Pilot narration
pills.pop_html: On board: Headsets so you can hear the pilot's English narration; an optional English audio guide is offered too.

best_for.pick_html: for guests staying on the Palm because it takes off and lands at Atlantis, and for anyone who wants to pick a 15-minute route that adds The World Islands.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a window seat guaranteed on a shared flight: only 3 of the 6 seats are at a window.

items.a: Helicopter flight of the length you select, headsets.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
Atlantis The Palm; varies by option, confirm when you book.
Max 110 kg per passenger on shared flights; not suitable for people with heart problems or wheelchair users.
6 seats per helicopter, 3 window seats.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

pills.label: Old Dubai + Creek
pills.pop_html: What the extra time adds: Heritage area with its wind towers, the Old Souk and Dubai Creek, plus the Dubai Frame, the UAE's largest flag and Meydan Racecourse.

pills.label: €14.58 per minute
pills.pop_html: Price per minute: €321 for 22 minutes. That is €87 more than the 17-minute flight for 5 more minutes, at almost the same per-minute rate.

pills.label: 13 landmarks
pills.pop_html: Full landmark list: Burj Al Arab, The Palm Islands, The World Islands, Ain Dubai, Emirates Golf, Jumeirah Lakes, Dubai Canal, Port Rashid, UAE's Largest Flag, Old Dubai Heritage, Dubai Frame, Meydan Racecourse and Jumeirah Beach.

pills.label: Audio guide included
pills.pop_html: On board: Live English guide plus an included English audio guide. Wheelchair accessible, private option available.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who wants old and new Dubai in one flight, because 22 minutes is the shortest route that reaches the Creek, the Old Souk and the Dubai Frame.
best_for.skip_html: if the Palm and Burj Khalifa are all you need: #1 shows them for €145 less.

items.a: 22-minute helicopter flight, live guide, English audio guide.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
HeliDubai, Dubai Police Academy, Dubai.

Burj Al Arab, The Palm Islands, The World Islands, Ain Dubai, Emirates Golf, Jumeirah Lakes, Dubai Canal, Port Rashid, UAE's Largest Flag, Old Dubai Heritage, Dubai Frame, Meydan Racecourse, Jumeirah Beach.
Age 2+, minimum 16 kg for children, under 120 kg per passenger, lenses under 400 mm.

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.

pills.label: Marina to the Creek
pills.pop_html: Route: Mall of the Emirates, Jumeirah Lakes and Emirates Hills, Dubai Marina and Ain Dubai, Burj Al Arab, the Palm and Atlantis, The World Islands, Burj Khalifa, Port Rashid, the Dubai Frame and Dubai Creek's heritage village.

pills.label: €14.57 per minute
pills.pop_html: Price per minute: €437 for 30 minutes. The 8 minutes over the 22-minute flight cost €116, so length does not get you a discount.

pills.label: Max 5 guests
pills.pop_html: Group size: Small group limited to 5 participants, with commentary from the pilot and an included English audio guide.

pills.label: Transfer add-on
pills.pop_html: Extras: Return transfer only if you add it at checkout. Photos and videos are available for purchase after the flight.

best_for.pick_html: for a once-in-a-trip splurge that covers Dubai Marina, Emirates Hills and Mall of the Emirates as well as the Dubai Frame and the Creek, the widest loop on this page.
best_for.skip_html: if budget matters: the 22-minute flight reaches Old Dubai and the Creek for €116 less.

items.a: 30-minute helicopter tour, commentary by the pilots.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
HeliDubai Helicopter Tours, Dubai Police Academy, Al Sufouh 1, Dubai.
Return transfer only if the add-on is selected at checkout.
Children under 2, people with mobility impairments or pre-existing medical conditions.

title.text: Dubai: Helicopter Ride, Desert Safari, Camels & Refreshments

pills.label: 12-min flight
pills.pop_html: The helicopter part: A 12-minute ride from Palm Jumeirah at the end of the day, over the Palm, Burj Al Arab, The World Islands and Burj Khalifa.

pills.label: Lahbab red dunes
pills.pop_html: The desert part: 4WD dune bashing, sandboarding, a camel ride (repeat as often as you like) and a falcon experience. Quad biking only if you select that option.

pills.label: Hotel pickup
pills.pop_html: Transport: Pickup from your hotel in an air-conditioned 4WD. The 6 hours include the transfer to the helicopter meeting point at the Palm.

pills.label: Tent refreshments
pills.pop_html: In camp: Air-conditioned tent with Arabic tea, coffee and dates, plus cold mineral water and soft drinks.

best_for.pick_html: for travellers with one free day who want both the desert and the skyline: the desert half costs about €97 on top of a 12-minute flight, with hotel pickup.
best_for.skip_html: if you want an evening desert camp with dinner and shows; this trip serves refreshments, not dinner.

items.a: 12-minute helicopter ride ticket, dune bashing, sandboarding, camel ride, falcon experience, water and soft drinks, Arabic tea, coffee and dates in an air-conditioned tent, licensed safari guide.
Free cancellation up to 2 days before.
Hotel pickup in an air-conditioned 4WD; the 6 hours include the transfer to the helicopter meeting point.
115 kg per passenger for the helicopter; not suitable for children under 3, pregnant women, people with back or heart problems, wheelchair users.
Quad biking (if selected).

price.note: The price depends on the date and the option you pick. Final price shown before you pay.
